Reference image for the [[Jokes]] row on [[Womp Rat]]: the Death Star's thermal exhaust port in ''Star Wars'' (1977), as Luke Skywalker's proton torpedoes reach it at the end of the trench run (one torpedo is the glowing shape at the bottom left). Cropped to the picture area (the letterbox bars removed), 640 by 270 pixels.

Source: a frame at 0:30 of [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSIDI9JwPI4 Luke Destroys the Deathstar], Rich Cathers, YouTube (17 March 2022), a clip of the film ''Star Wars'' (1977), written and directed by George Lucas, Lucasfilm and 20th Century Fox. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027142614/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MSIDI9JwPI4 Internet Archive], 27 October 2026.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: one low-resolution frame from the film, showing the exhaust port that the card's lore uses as a unit of size. It is used only to identify that work beside the card on [[Jokes]]. It cannot replace the original or harm its market, and no free image of it exists.
